usedFor: DitCal holds your bookings and Google Docs keeps the log, so “New Booking” runs “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in DitCal, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new booking is written into a doc tab, so the day's meetings sit on one page.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace what is in the tab, so check it is set to add.
